props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state of the combobox when it is initially rendered.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the combobox when initially rendered.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the Combobox.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The controlled value of the Combobox. Can be bound with `v-model`.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether multiple options can be selected.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the combobox for form submission.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the Combobox. Can be bound with `v-model:open`.

props.name: required
props.description: When `true`, indicates that the user must select a value.

props.name: resetModelValueOnClear
props.description: When `true`, the `modelValue` resets to `null` (or `[]` if `multiple`) on clear.

props.name: resetSearchTermOnBlur
props.description: Whether to reset the searchTerm when the Combobox is closed.

props.name: resetSearchTermOnSelect
props.description: Whether to reset the searchTerm when the Combobox value is selected.

slots.name: default
slots.type: { open: boolean; modelValue: T | T[] | undefined; }
